children: Aon provided audited 2025 and unaudited H1 2026 USI financials and pro forma combined statements in connection with its pending merger with USI Advantage.
Filed audited USI consolidated financials for year ended Dec 31, 2025, with an EY unqualified opinion.
2025 USI revenues were $2,971,997 and net income was $60,820, per the audited statements.
Unaudited USI six‑month results to June 30, 2026: total revenues $1,528,934 and net loss $(15,964).
Included unaudited pro forma combined financial statements reflecting the Merger and related transactions as if effective June 30, 2026 (balance sheet) and Jan 1, 2025 (income).
Pro forma information is for illustrative purposes only and based on assumptions; not a prediction of actual combined results.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
